title: 第一卷 第7章 她叫我，叫我哥哥~~~
slug: 七零随军大院来了个软美人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

季望棉撑着下巴：“萧大哥～我想给我爸妈写封信，告诉他们咱们的事情，你觉得可以吗？”

萧临戍巴不得，放下筷子：“当然，我不能没名没分的。”

最好现在就写！

起身回房，拿出一张红道白底的信纸，和一支笔，把一叠钱放桌子。

季望棉抬头看他。

萧临戍轻咳一声：“既然要告知家长就要正式，这是三百六十七块钱，这是我的彩……彩礼钱，你别误会，我不是催你，我的意思是为了防止别人攻击你，那你放心，如果哪天你不愿意了，我就告诉别人，是我配不上你，彩礼不用退！信，一会我去给你寄。”

骗你的，拿了我的彩礼就不能不认账！

这样你跟他就没关系了。

以后生了孩子，倒是可以喊对方叔叔，不行，万一自己生的闺女太可爱，被盯上怎么办。

真是幸福的烦恼。

季望棉故意逗他：“真的都给我吗？你父母那边……”

“没事，他们不会反对的！”

反对也无效，谁让他们居然给他下迷药，直接送到这鸟不拉屎的地方。

萧临戍往前推了推：“我知道这些不多，但是你放心，明天就多了，很多人欠我的账呢，平时我还有补贴什么的，养你足够了。”

季望棉眼神闪了闪。

是个大款呢！！

嘴角带笑：“那我就拿着了！”

“拿，下个月工资也都给你，我，我不花钱！”

季望棉：“怎么可能不花钱，你需要用钱就跟我要！”

但是不能要太多，钱到我手里就是我的！

萧临戍没听出她的潜台词，倒是被突然有老婆管的幸福感包围。

“还有布票呢，真好，我已经很多年没做过衣服了，不过没关系，男人出门在外最重要的是脸面，这些足够给你做身衣服了，萧大哥～你喜欢什么颜色？”

我可以问，但是你最好拒绝！！！

“不用！”萧临戍立刻反对：“你的衣服太薄了，你自己做两身袄子穿，我再去给你弄点棉花票，以后你想做几身衣服都可以。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ji Wangmian held up his chin: "Brother Xiao~ I want to write a letter to my parents and tell them about us. Do you think it's okay?"

Xiao Linshu was eager and put down his chopsticks: "Of course, I can't live without a name or status."

Better write now!

He got up and went back to his room, took out a piece of red letter paper with a white background, a pen, and put a stack of money on the table.

Ji Wangmian looked up at him.

Xiao Linshu coughed lightly: "Since we want to inform our parents, we need to make it official. This is three hundred and sixty-seven yuan. This is my gift...the gift money. Don't get me wrong. I'm not rushing you. I mean to prevent others from attacking you. Don't worry. If one day you don't want to, I will tell others that I am not worthy of you. There is no need to return the gift! I will send you a letter later."

I lied to you. If you took my bride price, you have to admit it!

This way you have nothing to do with him.

If you give birth to a child in the future, you can call the other person uncle, but no, what if the daughter you give birth to is too cute and is targeted.

What a happy trouble.

Ji Wangmian deliberately teased him: "Do you really give it all to me? Your parents..."

"It's okay, they won't object!"

His objections were ineffective, but they actually drugged him and sent him directly to this place where birds don't shit.

Xiao Linshu pushed forward: "I know these are not much, but don't worry, there will be more tomorrow. Many people owe me debts. I usually have subsidies and other things, which is enough to support you."

Ji Wangmian's eyes flashed.

He's a rich man!!

With a smile on his lips: "Then I'll take it!"

"Take it, I'll give you all of next month's salary, I, I don't have to spend any money!"

Ji Wangmian: "How can you not spend money? If you need money, just ask me for it!"

But you can’t ask for too much, the money is mine when it comes to me!

Xiao Linshu didn't hear her subtext, but he was surrounded by the happiness of suddenly having a wife in charge.

"There are also cloth coupons. It's great. I haven't made clothes for many years, but it doesn't matter. The most important thing for a man is his face when he goes out. These are enough to make clothes for you. Brother Xiao, what color do you like?"

I could ask, but you'd better say no!!!

"No!" Xiao Linshu objected immediately: "Your clothes are too thin. You can make two coats to wear yourself. I will get you some cotton coupons. You can make as many clothes as you want in the future."
